blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Tuesday urged Sen. Alan Peter Cayetano to lead by example and pitch in to help pay the national debt after his suggestion for the government to pass the hat and let “generous” Filipinos foot a portion of the bill. Palace press officer Claire Castro made the remark after Cayetano on Monday floated the idea of allowing “generous” Filipinos to voluntarily donate over P170,000 each to pay for the national government debt. “If there are kindhearted people willing to contribute, and since he was the one who initiated the idea, perhaps it would be better for us […]...
